vulnerable_code:
class ProductCertificatesController < ApplicationController
  def download
    # Fetches product by ID without checking if the compliance certificate is published or draft
    @product = Product.find(params[:product_id])
    redirect_to rails_blob_url(@product.compliance_certificate)
  end
end
diagnosis: The download action redirects to the product compliance_certificate blob without verifying if the product is in published status or belongs to the vendor's catalog. Third-party vendors can inspect unreleased safety certifications and regulatory test results of competitor products before public product launches.
exploit_request:
GET /api/catalog/products/prd_8812/certificate HTTP/1.1
Host: marketplace.supplier-network.com
Authorization: Bearer vendor_token_40
Accept: */*
corrected_code:
class ProductCertificatesController < ApplicationController
  def download
    @product = Product.find(params[:product_id])
    unless @product.published? || (current_vendor && current_vendor.id == @product.vendor_id)
      return render_unauthorized
    end

    redirect_to rails_blob_url(@product.compliance_certificate)
  end
end
